name: Nakamaki Yuusu
source: A third-year student and member of the Pet Maid department. Considered a "Rarity" for still being a total virgin, his value has made him a highly sought-after national treasure, and he was bought by Nagami. He's an airheaded eccentric type, and is very dedicated to Nagami.
